<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def show_diff(bf, af, label):
    bl = bf.ascii.split('\n')
    al = af.ascii.split('\n')
    diffs = []
    for r in range(min(len(bl), len(al))):
        if bl[r] != al[r]:
            changes = [(c, bl[r][c], al[r][c]) for c in range(len(bl[r])) if bl[r][c] != al[r][c]]

                diffs.append((r, changes))
    print(f"{label} diffs:")
    for r, ch in diffs:
        print(f"  row {r}: {ch}")

# Probe DOWN
print("=== Probing DOWN ===")
res = action(['DOWN'])

    show_diff(last_transition.before_frame, last_transition.after_frame, "DOWN")
